claims.text: Patch tokenisation reduces long-horizon error accumulation for PatchTST on ETTh1, ETTm1, Electricity.
PatchTST is best characterised as patch-based channel-independent transformer.

evidence.description: PatchTST shows a 27% smaller MSE increase from horizon 336 to 720 than autoregressive transformer baselines.

limitations.text: Attention weights are not analysed, leaving the interpretability claims unverified.
Hyperparameters are tuned per-dataset, which advantages larger models that can absorb the added capacity.

future_work.text: Pretraining on a mixture of datasets to test transfer.
